panels.description: Older Alex fits TJ's body together on the dock; one leg is missing. Leave upper dock space.
The granddaughter turns the broken component over; a small maker's mark is visible. Leave upper space.
The tanker becomes a dark speck across the lake and terraces. Leave open sky and water.
The component's amber indicator blinks beside an open public water terminal. Leave upper terminal space.

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: How did you get this lake?

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: That mark’s on the old pumps.

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: Do you know who sent them?
